run_main_generate_views: run main to generate views.py from template files for a given number of endpoints
run_main_generate_urls: run main to generate urls.py with Django URL patterns for feed_timeline, timeline, bundle_tray, inbox, and seen endpoints
run_main_generate_urls_template: run main to generate urls_template.txt with HTTP endpoint URLs and weights for load testing
run_main_with_custom_count: run main with a custom endpoint count argument to generate scaled Django workload files
review_main_endpoint_list: review the endpoint_list variable to see which Django endpoints are generated: feed_timeline, timeline, bundle_tray, inbox, seen
